description: Korean mandatory occupational safety and health training hours (산업안전보건법 시행규칙 별표 4, amended 2025-05-30): regular training 6 hours per half-year for office and sales workers, 12 hours for others; on hiring 8 hours (1 week-1 month contracts 4, daily or ≤1 week 1); on job change 2 hours (daily 1); supervisors 16 hours a year; construction day workers 4-hour basic training; half hours for wholesale/lodging/restaurant workplaces under 50 workers. Returns per-worker hours and the yearly total.

half.description: Wholesale, lodging or restaurant business with under 50 workers (half hours)

hire.description: Over 1 month, 1 week-1 month, up to 1 week fixed-term, or daily worker

job.description: Office work, sales work, or other (production, field)

name: calculate_kr_safety_education_hours
title: calculate kr safety education hours
